text: Bitcoin's modest gain masks consolidation near $81k while Ethereum outpaces it with a 1.4% move, suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite neutral market sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 50 with a 13-point weekly decline indicates cooling momentum despite stable pricing, and BTC dominance holding above 59% shows capital hasn't rotated sharply toward alternatives despite the broader market holding steady. Total volume of $67B sits at moderate levels, consistent with a market in wait-and-see mode rather than accumulation or distribution.
